comments.content: Implement forge §7.1 structural vacuity triage (vacuity.rs: checks a/b/c/d + VacuityVerdict) + the #[slag] escape hatch (slag.rs: field validation -> SlagMeta), wired into check::check_file BEFORE the L3 verus proof. manifest.rs gains additive slag_meta/RejectReason; contract_quality.{tautology,vacuous_precondition} graduate to live-false on a triage pass. comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
SHIPPED — §7.1 structural vacuity triage + #[slag], wired into forge check as a pre-verus gate. forge/src/vacuity.rs: the 4 FREE/syntactic checks (a) ens-is-trivial [literal true / identity comparison], (b) ens-omits-result [non-unit return, walks the ens tree, unit exempt], (c) ens-implied-by-req [whole postcondition syntactically implied — every ens clause is a req conjunct], (d) maximal-fx-without-slag [all 8 effect kinds + no slag]. forge/src/slag.rs: #[slag] field validation (reason/owner/review present + non-empty trimmed) + semantics. Wiring: a vacuous contract -> cert L0 + reject{cause} (verdict-in-cert, forge check exits non-zero); a valid #[slag] fn -> L1 + slag:true + slag_meta (L3-exempt, L1-enforced), triage (a)(b)(c) still apply (slag exempts proving not stating; only (d) is slag-justified). contract_quality.tautology/vacuous_precondition now LIVE-false on a passing item (graduated from forward-declared; mutants_killed/survivor stay forward-declared for #12).

Loop: doc-author -> oracle (conformance/vacuity + conformance/slag, 12 parse-verified programs) -> builder -> critic (found #44) -> fixer. #44: the (c) check over-rejected (any-clause-implied instead of all-clauses-implied) -> fixed to all. Critic otherwise NO DIVERGENCE (a/b/d correct, slag-exempts-proving-not-stating, generality grep clean, corpus L3 + live contract_quality, additive reject/slag_meta cert fields don't break the golden). Verified: partial-implication -> L3, fully-implied -> L0+EnsImpliedByReq, ens-true -> L0, slag -> L1+slag:true. Commits: 838374d (build) -> 71920e2 (critic #44) -> 2164770 (fix). forge 58 tests, workspace green, clippy/fmt clean. The slag cert level = L1+slag:true resolves a §6(L0-row)/§8(L1-enforced) thesis tension -> flagged for a possible §6 clarification (like §4.2). Not pushed.
